title: Team Performance Domain
coreMove: Manage Team Performance Domain as evidence of delivery capacity: check the team charter, working agreements, conflict, leadership, and domain interactions before praising activity volume.

exampleSpecs.audience: facilitators who trust signed agreements too quickly
exampleSpecs.stakes: private conflict may look like calm while team performance degrades
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the protagonist thinks through wrong readings before naming the team-domain signal

exampleSpecs.audience: project leads choosing where scarce review time goes
exampleSpecs.stakes: planning may absorb a problem that belongs to team performance
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the protagonist allocates limited attention before any workshop action occurs

exampleSpecs.stakes: protecting a date can normalize behavior that damages later delivery
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the protagonist confronts two bad choices and chooses the team-domain evidence

exampleSpecs.stakes: fast escalation can create rework when working agreements are skipped
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: two named people let the lesson emerge through a short exchange

exampleSpecs.stakes: the expected planning fix may miss the team-domain cause
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the expected planning answer breaks when team-domain evidence appears

exampleSpecs.audience: remote project teams preparing a domain check
exampleSpecs.stakes: the review may stay on schedule and delivery while the team signal is missed
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: a short message thread lands the lesson between compressed replies
